Class DateUtils

public class DateUtils

Utility class for Date and Datetime data type operations including timezone conversions, Unix time conversion, and day of week calculations. Provides methods to convert datetimes between different timezones (GMT, local, custom) and extract weekday information.

Group:
    Utilities

Since:
    12/30/2023

Version:

Change Log

  • 12/30/2023 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 09/22/2024 - v1.1 - Added weekDay() method to get day of week for specified date.
  • 11/08/2025 - v1.2 - Added getUnixTime() method to convert Datetime to Unix time. Method getDatetime() moved from JSONUtils class to this class.

public static Datetime getDatetime(
  String dt,
  String format
)

Parses a datetime string according to a specified format pattern. Supports custom date/time format parsing with the following tokens:
  • yyyy: 4-digit year
  • yy: 2-digit year (50-99 = 1900s, 00-49 = 2000s)
  • MM: 2-digit month
  • dd: 2-digit day
  • HH: 2-digit hour (24-hour format)
  • mm: 2-digit minutes
  • ss: 2-digit seconds

Parameters:
    dt – Datetime string to parse.
    format – Format pattern describing the structure of the datetime string.

Returns:
    Parsed Datetime value.

Example: 
getDatetime('2025-11-01 14:30:00', 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
getDatetime('01/11/25', 'dd/MM/yy')
